question: Are there truly better routes than the proposed HYBRID route for policy.git retirement, and can easy agreement be ruled out?

constraints.canonicalAuthority: SSOT only; GitHub refs are transport mirror
constraints.debateRequirement: Both Gen2 reviewers must attack the route, produce counterexamples, evaluate alternatives, and avoid easy consensus.

initialRouteUnderDebate: HYBRID: freeze completed proposal validators as bounded evidence; create minimal markdown ontology -> append-only JSONL facts -> deterministic reducers/projections; convert proposal validators to regression fixtures and use proposal validators only for acceptance-critical transitions.

alternativesConsidered: archive-only clean break / old corpus historical only

counterexamples.case: Markdown table defines role-to-authority constraints but extractor only reads headings and MUST/MUST NOT sentences.
counterexamples.requiredControl: mdBlock must include table cells as addressable spans; table-only meaning extracted or blocked unresolved.

counterexamples.case: Quoted anti-pattern contains MUST and extractor emits false authority.
counterexamples.requiredControl: quote/example/generated/non-authority disposition must precede semantic extraction.

counterexamples.case: Validators remain standalone lanes and pass while ontology reducer disagrees.
counterexamples.requiredControl: validators become regression fixtures consumed by reducer; reducer output is the only corpus gate matrix.

counterexamples.case: JSONL row explosion harms due diligence.
counterexamples.requiredControl: mandatory generated README.audit.md, authority matrix, gate matrix, unresolved matrix, source-to-rule drilldown.

counterexamples.case: Schema churn silently reinterprets old append-only rows.
counterexamples.requiredControl: schemaVersion/extractorVersion/reducerVersion and explicit adapters; no silent reinterpretation.
only authority-relevant unresolved rows block retirement; non-authority unresolved rows block completeness score only.

counterexamples.case: Owner wants clean governance story rather than preserving every legacy rule wart.
counterexamples.requiredControl: requires explicit owner/root approval accepting semantic loss and consumer breakage; absent that, not admissible.

counterexamples.case: Behavior-first catches practical failures faster than ontology.
counterexamples.requiredControl: use behavior tests as destructive fixtures, not replacement for source-span equivalence.

blockingHardening: Extraction ordering must be sourceFile -> mdBlock -> authorityDisposition/currentness -> normativeSignal -> semanticCandidate -> semanticRecord.
Reducers must enforce non-promotion; laneKind/authorityFlags alone are insufficient.
Proposal validators must be imported as regression fixtures and acceptance-critical gates only.
Separate spanCoverage, signalCoverage, semanticCoverage, behaviorCoverage, and buyerProjectionCoverage.
Every row must include source hash, span, schemaVersion, extractorVersion, reducerVersion, and authority disposition.
Generated buyer-facing projections must be required outputs, not optional docs.

acceptedBClaims: table-only policy meaning is a real authority surface
disposition must happen before semantic extraction
validator PASS must never override ontology BLOCK
due diligence requires readable audit views
append-only meaning requires schema/extractor/reducer versions and explicit adapters
authority-relevant unresolved rows block retirement/cutover/promotion while non-authority unresolved rows only lower completeness score
radical constitution can beat only with explicit owner/root acceptance of semantic loss and consumer breakage
behavior-first is stronger for runtime safety but cannot prove corpus retirement coverage alone
refutedOrNarrowedBClaims: validators can remain local acceptance-critical lane evidence, but cannot satisfy or override corpus-retirement reducer gates
unresolved rows must not block ingestion, indexing, raw inventory, or non-authority projections

finalRoute.name: COVERAGE_FIRST_HARDENED_HYBRID
finalRoute.summary: Freeze proposal validators as curated regression evidence; run markdown ontology extraction as main corpus route; reduce mdBlock/normativeSignal/semanticCandidate/regressionFixture rows into a single gateMatrix; only gateMatrix supports corpus promotion/retirement readiness; local validators cannot override corpus BLOCK.
finalRoute.exactReducerRule: For gates semanticPromotion, ownerAdoptionForCorpus, policyRetirement, policyDeletion, cutover, canonicalWrite, ssotAdoption: gate.status = BLOCK if corpusProjection.status == BLOCK or authorityRelevantUnresolved.count > 0 or requiredSemanticCoverage.status != PASS or sourceSpanIntegrity.status != PASS. validatorPass fixtures may set regressionCoverage[validatorId]=PASS only; they cannot set gate.status=PASS and cannot decrement authorityRelevantUnresolved.count.
finalRoute.ordering: sourceFile -> mdBlock/tableCellBlock -> blockDisposition/currentness -> normativeSignal -> semanticCandidate -> acceptedSemanticRecord
finalRoute.candidatePromotionRule: accepted semantic authority requires source span/hash/integrity, recorded versions, normative disposition, destructive fixtures pass, zero conflicts, reviewer acceptance; owner/cutover/canonical gates remain false unless separately approved

remainingCounterexamples: table semantics across split rows, merged cells, or context
buyer trust gap in generated projections
owner reset route can beat if owner accepts loss/breakage
consumer cutover not solved by corpus proof

betterRouteIfAny.reason: Under current constraints no stronger route beats it. DSL-first loses traceable migration safety, data-room-first packages evidence without enforcing semantics, behavior-test-first cannot prove corpus coverage, and burn-down constitution requires owner/root acceptance of semantic loss and breakage.

remainingCounterexampleDisposition.counterexample: table semantics across split rows, merged cells, inherited headers, footnotes, or surrounding prose context
remainingCounterexampleDisposition.requiredCoverage: tableCellBlock must support rowHeader, colHeader, caption, footnote, previousHeadingContext, mergedCellApproximation, and unresolvedTableSemantics; any table-only rule not represented blocks semanticPromotion.
blockDisposition must be reviewer-checkable, source-spanned, destructive-fixture-backed, and reducer-enforced; conflicts or low-confidence authority rows block retirement gates.
generated audit views must include hashes, refs, human-readable rationale, and replay instructions.
requires explicit owner/root approval accepting semantic loss and consumer breakage.
consumerCutoverGate remains separate and BLOCK until consumers use accepted projections and pass runtime/e2e checks.
conflictMatrix and supersessionGraph are required; zero unresolved coverage is insufficient without zero unresolved authority conflicts.

remainingCounterexampleDisposition.counterexample: schema adapters silently reinterpret old rows
remainingCounterexampleDisposition.requiredCoverage: schemaVersion, extractorVersion, reducerVersion, adapterVersion, migrationLossReport, and old/new projection diff mandatory for promoted schema migration.

proposalMustInclude: reducer-produced gateMatrix as only corpus promotion/retirement readiness artifact
validatorPass cannot set retirement/cutover/canonical/SSOT gates to PASS and cannot reduce unresolved count
separate layers for sourceFile, mdBlock, tableCellBlock, blockDisposition, currentness, normativeSignal, semanticCandidate, acceptedSemanticRecord
disposition and currentness before semantic extraction
tables, quotes, examples, generated output, diagrams, and superseded text first-class or explicit unresolved blockers
separate metrics for spanCoverage, tableCoverage, signalCoverage, semanticCoverage, behaviorCoverage, conflictCoverage, consumerCoverage, buyerProjectionCoverage
acceptedSemanticRecord requires source path/hash/span, schemaVersion, extractorVersion, reducerVersion, disposition, reviewer acceptance, destructive fixture pass, conflict status
authorityRelevantUnresolved > 0 blocks semanticPromotion, ownerAdoptionForCorpus, policyRetirement, policyDeletion, cutover, canonicalWrite, ssotAdoption
generated buyer-facing projections mandatory and reproducible from JSONL
consumer cutover and e2e retirement remain later gates even after semantic equivalence passes
